title: Waste management plan for apartments (Note)
text: Note: Where apartments are proposed, a waste management plan to the satisfaction of the decision-maker, is to be provided.

replaces.note: deemed-to-comply waste management plan for multiple dwellings reduced to a Note

verified.note: Printed as an italic Note under C2.4.3 (p21); whether a Note binds as a deemed exempt provision is not stated.

notes: from: ch3 C2.4.3-r1. diverges: applies to every apartment development, so no five-dwelling condition. Printed as a Note after C2.4.3; 'to the satisfaction of the decision-maker' needs a planner, so judgment. verify: whether a Note binds as a deemed exempt provision (register C4P1-052).
